SELECT SUM(rm.total_custo)
FROM resumo_soma_dia_mes_ano_recurso rm
JOIN recurso_nuvem rn ON rn.id_recurso = rm.id_recurso_resumo
WHERE rn.id_provedor IN (1)
  AND ano = EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND rn.nome IN ($servico)
  AND (rn.regiao IN ($regiao) OR rn.regiao IS NULL OR rn.regiao = '')
  AND rn.tipo_recurso IN ($recurso);

SELECT SUM(rm.total_custo)
FROM resumo_soma_dia_mes_ano_recurso rm
JOIN recurso_nuvem rn ON rn.id_recurso = rm.id_recurso_resumo
WHERE rn.id_provedor IN (1)
  AND ano = EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
  AND mes = EXTRACT(month FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
  AND rn.nome IN ($servico)
  AND (rn.regiao IN ($regiao) OR rn.regiao IS NULL OR rn.regiao = '')
  AND rn.tipo_recurso IN ($recurso);

SELECT SUM(rm.total_custo)
FROM resumo_soma_dia_mes_ano_recurso rm
JOIN recurso_nuvem rn ON rn.id_recurso = rm.id_recurso_resumo
WHERE rn.id_provedor IN (1)
  AND rn.nome IN ($servico)
  AND (rn.regiao IN ($regiao) OR rn.regiao IS NULL OR rn.regiao = '')
  AND rn.tipo_recurso IN ($recurso)
  AND ano = EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND mes = EXTRACT(month FROM CURRENT_DATE);

WITH ultimos_tres_meses AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.mes,
        SUM(rm.total_custo) AS total_custo
    FROM 
        resumo_soma_dia_mes_ano_recurso rm
    JOIN 
        recurso_nuvem rn ON rn.id_recurso = rm.id_recurso_resumo
    WHERE 
        rn.id_provedor IN (1)
        AND (rm.ano, rm.mes) >= (
            EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) - CASE 
                WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 3 THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END, 
            EXTRACT(month FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3
        )
        AND (rm.ano, rm.mes) < (EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE), EXTRACT(month FROM CURRENT_DATE))
        AND rn.nome IN ($servico)
        AND (rn.regiao IN ($regiao) OR rn.regiao IS NULL OR rn.regiao = '')
        AND rn.tipo_recurso IN ($recurso)
    GROUP BY 
        rm.mes
),
media_tres_meses AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(total_custo) AS media_custo
    FROM 
        ultimos_tres_meses
)
SELECT 
    media_custo AS projecao_custo
FROM 
    media_tres_meses;

WITH meses_passados AS (
    SELECT
        rm.mes,
        SUM(rm.total_custo) AS total_custo
    FROM
        resumo_soma_dia_mes_ano_recurso rm
    JOIN
        recurso_nuvem rn ON rn.id_recurso = rm.id_recurso_resumo
    WHERE
        rn.id_provedor IN (1)
        AND rm.ano = EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE)  -- Usa o ano atual
        AND rn.nome IN ($servico)
        AND (rn.regiao IN ($regiao) OR rn.regiao IS NULL OR rn.regiao = '')
        AND rn.tipo_recurso IN ($recurso)
    GROUP BY
        rm.mes
),
media_mensal AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(total_custo) AS media_custo_mensal
    FROM
        meses_passados
),
projecao_ano AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(total_custo) AS total_acumulado_ano,
        12 - COUNT(mes) AS meses_faltantes
    FROM
        meses_passados
)
SELECT
    total_acumulado_ano + (media_custo_mensal * meses_faltantes) AS projecao_total_ano
FROM
    media_mensal, projecao_ano;

WITH ultimos_tres_meses AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.mes,
        SUM(rm.total_custo) AS total_custo
    FROM 
        resumo_soma_dia_mes_ano_recurso rm
    JOIN 
        recurso_nuvem rn ON rn.id_recurso = rm.id_recurso_resumo
    WHERE 
        (rm.ano, rm.mes) >= (
            EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) - CASE 
                WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM CURRENT_DATE) <= 3 THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END, 
            EXTRACT(month FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3
        )
        AND rn.nome IN ($servico)
        AND (rn.regiao IN ($regiao) OR rn.regiao IS NULL OR rn.regiao = '')
        AND rn.tipo_recurso IN ($recurso)
        AND rm.ano IN ($ano)
        AND rm.mes IN ($mes)
    GROUP BY 
        rm.mes
),
media_tres_meses AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(total_custo) AS media_custo
    FROM 
        ultimos_tres_meses
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN rm.mes = 1 THEN 'Jan/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 2 THEN 'Fev/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 3 THEN 'Mar/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 4 THEN 'Abr/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 5 THEN 'Mai/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 6 THEN 'Jun/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 7 THEN 'Jul/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 8 THEN 'Ago/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 9 THEN 'Set/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 10 THEN 'Out/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 11 THEN 'Nov/' || $ano1
            WHEN rm.mes = 12 THEN 'Dez/' || $ano1
        END AS mes,
        SUM(rm.total_custo) AS total_custo,
        NULL AS projecao
    FROM 
        resumo_soma_dia_mes_ano_recurso rm
    JOIN 
        recurso_nuvem rn ON rn.id_recurso = rm.id_recurso_resumo
    WHERE 
        rn.nome IN ($servico)
        AND (rn.regiao IN ($regiao) OR rn.regiao IS NULL OR rn.regiao = '')
        AND rn.tipo_recurso IN ($recurso)
        AND rm.ano IN ($ano)
        AND rm.mes IN ($mes)
    GROUP BY 
        rm.mes

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        'Projeção mês atual' AS mes,
        NULL AS total_custo,
        mt.media_custo AS projecao
    FROM 
        media_tres_meses mt
) AS result
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN mes = 'Jan/' || $ano1 THEN 1
        WHEN mes = 'Fev/' || $ano1 THEN 2
        WHEN mes = 'Mar/' || $ano1 THEN 3
        WHEN mes = 'Abr/' || $ano1 THEN 4
        WHEN mes = 'Mai/' || $ano1 THEN 5
        WHEN mes = 'Jun/' || $ano1 THEN 6
        WHEN mes = 'Jul/' || $ano1 THEN 7
        WHEN mes = 'Ago/' || $ano1 THEN 8
        WHEN mes = 'Set/' || $ano1 THEN 9
        WHEN mes = 'Out/' || $ano1 THEN 10
        WHEN mes = 'Nov/' || $ano1 THEN 11
        WHEN mes = 'Dez/' || $ano1 THEN 12
        ELSE 13 -- Coloca 'Projeção mês atual' após os meses
    END;

targets.rawSql:
select
sum(total_custo)
from
resumo_soma_dia_mes_ano_recurso rm
join recurso_nuvem rn
on rn.id_recurso = rm.id_recurso_resumo 
where
rm.ano =  extract(year from date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)) 
and rm.mes = extract(month from date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE))
and dia >= extract(day from date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'))
and id_provedor = 1

SELECT
    rn.tipo_recurso,
    SUM(rm.total_custo)::decimal(30,2) AS total_custo
FROM
    resumo_soma_dia_mes_ano_recurso rm
JOIN 
    recurso_nuvem rn ON rn.id_recurso = rm.id_recurso_resumo 
WHERE
    rm.ano = EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE)
    AND rm.mes = EXTRACT(month FROM CURRENT_DATE)
    and dia >= extract(day from date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'))
    AND rn.id_provedor IN (1)
    AND rn.nome IN ($servico)
    AND rn.regiao IN ($regiao)
    AND rn.tipo_recurso IN ($recurso)
GROUP BY
    rn.tipo_recurso
ORDER BY
    total_custo DESC
LIMIT 6;
